title: AgentLighthouse Receipt v1
description: A mediator-signed, hash-chained record of one mediated decision. MIT.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, millisecond precision, trailing 'Z'.

target.description: What the action was against, e.g. tool:send_email.

verdict.description: Decision, in precedence order block > strip > warn > ask > allow.

block_reason.description: Fixed machine-readable reason vocabulary + retry hint (agent-legible denials).

policy_hash.description: sha256:... of the policy in force.

redaction.description: Redaction class -> count. Counts only; never plaintext.

session.description: Agent session the decision belongs to (taint/HITL scope), when one exists.

latency_ms.description: Milliseconds from request receipt to this decision (gateway actions).

prev_hash.description: record_hash of the previous receipt; genesis is 64 zeros.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 over JCS(receipt without record_hash and sig).

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (base64) over JCS(receipt without sig).
